# Motion.page Skills — Index for AI Agents

Use this file to discover which skill to load. Each skill lives in a directory of the same name under skills/ and contains SKILL.md.

## Skills

motion-sdk
  Complete guide for animating with @motion.page/sdk — triggers, timelines, text splitting, cursors, FLIP morphing, and more.
  Triggers: @motion.page/sdk, animation, animate elements, scroll animation, page transition, custom cursor, text reveal, Motion.page

desktop-mcp
  Guide for creating and editing animations in the Motion.page Desktop app via MCP tools. Covers tool tiers, common patterns, triggers, and best practices.
  Triggers: @motion.page/desktop-mcp, motionpage-desktop-mcp, MCP, desktop builder, create timeline, builder tools
